source_text: In neonatal and infant contexts, circumcision significantly decreases the incidence of urinary tract infections (UTIs) in the first year of life, with meta-analyses reporting relative risk reductions of 90% or greater compared to uncircumcised males; this benefit stems from the foreskin's role as a reservoir for uropathogenic bacteria. [3] [69]
